profile_text.body:
Manus AI is the company behind Manus, an autonomous AI agent that the company describes as an "action engine" designed to execute tasks and automate workflows rather than simply return answers. The product is positioned as a general-purpose agent intended to extend what users can accomplish, operating across a range of functions the site lists as web browsing, research, mail, AI design, AI slides, image generation, music generation, and a Slack integration.

The held facts classify Manus under Automation and Agents and note it carries high decision-influence, reflecting its autonomous, task-executing nature. No litigation, MCP server registrations, SEC filings, or patent records are present in the available data.
